messages.subject: "inspect "command error

Hello,

I am using factor ordered data.

The syntax is the next:
model<- "
DIM1=~E1+E2+E3+E4
DIM2=~M1+M2+M3+M4"

I have the next results:

> inspect(fit, "free")
Error in inspect(fit, "free") : unused argument ("free")

Error in inspect(fit, "start") : unused argument ("start")

Error in inspect(fit, "rsquare") : unused argument ("rsquare")

Error in inspect(fit, "fit") : unused argument ("fit")

Error in inspect(fit, "WLS.V") : unused argument ("WLS.V")

Thank you!

Alex
